source: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack while this spell is active, the ammunition becomes a bolt of lightning. On a hit the target takes 4d8 lightning damage instead of the weapon's normal damage, and half that on a miss. Either way, each creature within 10 feet of the target takes 2d8 lightning damage, halved on a successful Dexterity saving throw.
Minute Meteors

Six burning motes orbit you. Spend a bonus action to fling one or two at points up to 120 feet away; each detonates in a 5-foot radius for 2d6 fire damage, halved on a successful Dexterity saving throw.
Pulse Wave

You create intense pressure in a 30-foot cone and decide whether it pulls or pushes. Each creature there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6 force damage and being moved 15 feet on a failure, or half damage and no movement on a success.
Binding Ice

A burst of cold energy fills a 30-foot cone. Each creature there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 cold damage on a failure and being restrained by ice until it or another creature breaks it free with an action.
Spirit Shroud

Spirits gather around you out to 10 feet. Until the spell ends, any enemy that starts its turn in that area has its speed reduced by 10 feet and cannot regain hit points. Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 10 feet with an attack, it takes an extra 1d8 radiant, necrotic or cold damage of your choice.
Summon Fey

You call a fey spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. It takes a Fuming, Mirthful or Tricksy mood of your choosing and acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
Summon Lesser Demons

You summon demons at random: either two of challenge rating 1 or lower, four of rating 1/2 or lower, or eight of rating 1/4 or lower. They are not under your control and attack the nearest creature that is not a demon.
Summon Shadowspawn

You call a shadow spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. It takes a Fury, Despair or Fear emotion of your choosing and acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
Summon Undead
You call an undead spirit to an unoccupied space you can see. You choose a Ghostly, Putrid or Skeletal form, and it acts on your turn using your spellcasting numbers.
Thunder Step

You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within range, and thunder cracks at both your origin and your destination. Each creature within 10 feet of the space you left takes 3d10 thunder damage, halved on a successful Constitution saving throw. You can bring one willing creature with you.
Tidal Wave

You conjure a wave of water 30 feet long, 10 feet wide and 10 feet tall. Each creature in its space must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failure, or half damage on a success. The water then spreads out and extinguishes open flames.
Tiny Servant
You touch a Tiny nonmagical object and animate it as a servant with its own senses and speed. It obeys your spoken commands, though it cannot attack, and drops lifeless when the spell ends.
Wall of Sand
A wall of swirling sand up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 10 feet thick rises from the ground. It blocks sight entirely, and a creature moving through it does so at half speed.
Wall of Water

You conjure a wall of water up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ring 20 feet in diameter. Ranged weapon attacks passing through it have disadvantage, fire damage passing through is halved, and cold damage freezes it into difficult terrain.
Aura of Purity

A purifying aura of 30 feet radiates from you and moves with you. Friendly creatures in it, including you, cannot contract disease, have resistance to poison damage, have advantage on saves against effects that would blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison or stun, and have advantage on saves against other conditions.
Elemental Bane

You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder and curse a creature within range. On a failed Constitution saving throw it loses resistance to that damage type, and the first time it takes that damage each turn it takes an extra 2d6.
Find Greater Steed

You summon a loyal, intelligent spirit that takes the form of a griffon, pegasus, peryton, dire wolf, rhinoceros or saber-toothed tiger. It serves as a mount, shares your telepathic bond, and vanishes to a pocket of its own plane when it drops to 0 hit points, letting you resummon it later.
Conjured Tower
A tower of the size and style you choose rises from the ground, up to four storeys, furnished and stocked with food and light. Only those you name can enter.
Grasping Vine

You conjure a vine that sprouts from the ground at a point within range. As a bonus action on each of your turns you can direct it to lash at one creature within 30 feet of it, which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet directly toward the vine.
